about_the_game:
The game offers a virtual nature walk experience for everyone, with a concept based on real locations, taking you to the most beautiful and natural places in the Tisza Lake inspired nature of the lowlands.Realistic Atmosphere

Our main goal is to give you the opportunity to experience the tranquility and serenity of nature, with a unique hand-made and designed trail in a "Hyper-Realistic" environment. You will be able to choose from several different times of the day. From classic Tisza Lake sunrise to midnight

Realistic Character Movement

We feel it's important to match the realistic environment to the movement of your character, so distances can be more realistic than average

Realistic Sounds
The quality of the sounds is not to be missed either, with all the sounds of nature recorded in real life

Wildlife

Walking in nature you can see wildlife that blends in with the environment

Sports

Not only on land, but also on water you will have the opportunity to discover the beauty of nature
-Bike
-Kayak
-SUP
And much more you will love..

Cleaning up Nature!

Today, the amount of waste we "produce" is increasing, and it has become increasingly dangerous. We can find almost everything you see on the shelves of shops in the Tisza, not to mention chemicals invisible to the naked eye. Unfortunately, nature is nowadays also associated with litter, so let's not bury our heads in the sand and learn to pick it up.

Relaxation-Freedom-Gathering

In the game you have the opportunity to relax and enjoy the freedom of nature without time limits or distractions.
While cleaning up nature, you can read and collect notes to learn interesting facts about the environment, find pictures and other objects to unlock new levels and content.

Experience a true Virtual Nature Adventure!
